body:
## Summary

Repair merged dope-context Voyage modernization (PR #1112 / post-merge Opus audit FAIL) before first deployment.

### Audit source
- Parent: PR #1112 merge `4b42268775d1f94e26500c758128da3e11b151d5`
- Audit packet: `TP-DOPECONTEXT-VOYAGE4-POSTMERGE-OPUS-AUDIT-001` → `REPAIR_REQUIRED`
- This packet: `TP-DOPECONTEXT-VOYAGE4-REPAIR-0002`

### Blocking findings repaired
- **F-001** Code `content_vec` index/query vector-space mismatch → query uses same contextualized model/endpoint as index
- **F-002** Collection compatibility/migration gate → fingerprint-versioned collection names; legacy never written
- **F-003** Legacy-context rollback split → single `DOPE_CONTEXT_CONTEXTUAL_EMBED_MODEL` moves all contextual paths

### Design selected for code content_vec
Behavior-preserving: configured contextual model + `contextualized_embeddings` on both index and query (query: single chunk, auto-chunking off, exactly one vector). Title/breadcrumb remain `voyage-code-3` / embeddings.

### Collection migration behavior
- Active: `code_<ws-hash>_<profile-digest>` / `docs_<ws-hash>_<profile-digest>`
- Changing model/endpoint/dimension/dtype/chunker/schema → new collection identity
- Local manifest mismatch fails closed before upsert

### Legacy collection behavior
- Detected and reported in `get_index_status`
- Never selected for new writes
- Never auto-deleted

### Rollback command
```bash
export DOPE_CONTEXT_CONTEXTUAL_EMBED_MODEL=voyage-context-3
```

### Tests and validation
- Full dope-context suite: **74 passed**
- `uv lock --check` PASS (voyageai `>=0.5.0,<0.6`)
- Docker build `dope-context:repair-0002` PASS
- No-network container smoke: voyageai `0.5.0` SMOKE_OK

### Embedded auditor
- Preferred Gemini CLI / AGY / Claude Code Opus **blocked** this window (tier + quota)
- Verdict: **NOT_RUN** (implementer must not self-PASS)
- See `proof/TP-DOPECONTEXT-VOYAGE4-REPAIR-0002/AUDITOR_REPORT.md`

### Residual risks
- Independent embedded audit still required for steward READY
- No live Voyage billable benchmark
- Operator reindex required for legacy collections

### Deployment
**Explicitly NOT performed** in this packet.

## Test plan
- [x] `PYTHONPATH=services/dope-context uv run --extra services --extra test pytest -q services/dope-context/tests`
- [x] Docker build + no-network smoke
- [ ] Independent embedded audit PASS / PASS_WITH_RISKS
- [ ] PR Steward MERGE_READINESS=READY
- [ ] Do not deploy from this PR without operator approval

commits.messageBody:
Introduce canonical named-vector profiles and fingerprint-versioned
collection identity so index and query share the same model space, legacy
collections cannot receive mixed writes, and contextual rollback is a
single env var. Align code content_vec queries to contextualized embeddings,
harden tokenizer/rerank/budget/cache paths, and pin voyageai>=0.5.0,<0.6
for repo and image parity.

Packet: TP-DOPECONTEXT-VOYAGE4-REPAIR-0002
